svg.title: Deployment and monitoring workflow of step 4
svg.desc: The ML pipeline of step 3 registers the model package and writes the baseline to S3. The notebook approves the model package and deploys it to a real-time endpoint with data capture, sends test traffic with simulated drift, and stores the ground truth labels in S3. A monitoring pipeline, started from the notebook or by an optional EventBridge Scheduler schedule, runs a processing job with Evidently on the baseline, the captured data, and the ground truth. It logs reports and metrics in the MLflow app and publishes an SNS email alert when a check fails.
